Resolves #20320

The persistent-memory post gets one title and subtitle that serve both Google and Medium's preview card. The H1 now reads *Persistent memory for AI coding agents: no prompt stuffing*: the long-tail search phrase stays first, and the hook follows the colon. A subtitle line under it carries the number and the design: *Our AI agents keep 55,041 memories in an MCP server, not the prompt. Each session loads a small index; the agent asks the archive when it needs the past.* `blog.json`'s `name` matches. The body and the slug are unchanged.

Evidence: L1 (docs: the markdown and portal nav entry; `blog.json` parses) → L1 required for AC-1. AC-2 is the review itself; AC-3 is Post-Merge Validation.
